concept: VPC: private connectivity between two VPCs (Peering / PrivateLink)
tests: How to move data between two VPCs in the same Region without going over the internet.
expected: VPC Peering (whole-VPC connectivity) or AWS PrivateLink (access to a specific service): traffic stays on the AWS network. Triggers: "between two VPCs", "without traversing the public internet".
why_not: IGW and NAT Gateway lead to the internet; Site-to-Site VPN is for on-premises and adds needless complexity.
